result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, with oldest first within each priority. The full test suite passes (`mvn -q -o test`). I didn't add a test for your T-1 to T-5 example.

The change is in `DataStore.findOpenSupportTicketsOfCustomersInRegion` (`DataStore.java`, around line 5277). It now uses the same `highestPriorityFirst()` ordering as the sales rep's open-ticket list, and I updated its doc comment to match. Closed tickets and other regions' tickets are filtered out as before. The overview in `RegionManagerService` is the only caller of this method, so nothing else changes.
